notes.title: Cry Babies Magic Tears make their PC debut in The Big Game!
notes.notes:
Merge Games and IMC Toys are thrilled to announce that the Cry Babies Magic Tears friends are making their video game debut in The Big Game, releasing later this year. Wishlist this fun and friendly arcade adventure today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249357/812841fc707272583721e5dc6b6f8e3a11c0f66d.png[/img]

For more information check out the game's [url=https://www.mergegames.com/games/cry-babies-magic-tears-the-big-game/]official webpage[/url]. The game will also be available in physical editions for PlayStation consoles and Nintendo Switch, available for pre-order now from [url=https://signatureeditiongames.com/search?type=product&options%5Bprefix%5D=last&q=cry+babies]Signature Edition Games[/url].
